label: fewshot_demos_bbh
rule: per configuration and BIG-Bench Hard task, five of the task's pool items drawn without replacement, in the order drawn, from the pool in index order with numpy.random.default_rng seeded by the first 8 bytes of sha256('fewshot/bbh/<bbh task>/<config_id>')

pool.rule: each task's indices outside target, calibration, screening and malformed
